Subject: SIG: Incident response & breach notification - timeline and evidence request

Hi Priyom,

Quick follow-up from Acme's security review - thanks for taking SIG. We have a few clarifying questions to complete our audit:

1) Notification windows: for incidents affecting customer data, what is Redwood's standard customer notification timeline (initial acknowledgement vs confirmed breach notification)? Do you have an SLA or contractual window?
2) POCs: who should we contact for (a) initial triage, (b) legal/notification questions, and (c) forensic evidence requests?
3) Evidence: can you provide a redacted incident timeline template, a sample contact matrix, and an example of the logs you can provide for forensic review? Are there any limitations (e.g., raw disk images, KMS key material)?
4) Regulatory assistance: does Redwood support coordinating third-party notification (e.g., regulatory filings) or do you limit support to technical evidence?

Goal: we need to close these items for our procurement/security gate by next week. If helpful, we can do a quick 30-min sync - proposed slots: Tue Aug 31 9-11 PT or Wed Sep 1 13-15 PT.

Thanks - appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Morgan Ellis
Security Engineer, Acme Payments
security@acmepay.com

From: priyom_das@redwood.com

Subject: Re: SIG: Incident response & breach notification - timeline and evidence request

Morgan - thanks for the clear list. Short answer up front: initial acknowledgement within 24 hours of detection; confirmed customer notification within 72 hours of verification for incidents impacting customer data. I attached artifacts: a redacted timeline template and our contact matrix.

Details:
- Notification windows:
  • Initial ack: acknowledge receipt within 24 hours of detection.
  • Confirmed notification: notify affected customers within 72 hours of verification when customer data confidentiality/integrity is impacted. Specific contract windows can be adjusted by addendum.
- POCs:
  • Initial triage / operational: security@redwood.com (primary), on-call SRE (we provide direct phone/pager for high-severity).
  • Legal / notification: Neha Kapoor (neha_kapoor@redwood.com) - CC'd.
  • Forensic evidence requests: Rishi Malhotra (rishi_malhotra@redwood.com) - CC'd; infra can produce log exports and preserved artifacts.
- Evidence & limitations:
  • We can supply a redacted incident timeline, contact matrix, and redacted application logs (JSON/CSV exports).
  • Not provided: raw disk images or private KMS key material. We can provide key IDs, rotation history, and envelope encryption metadata.
  • Retention: detailed request logs and KV cache traces retained 90 days by default; extended retention available under contract.
- Regulatory assistance: Redwood provides technical evidence and templated notification wording but does not file regulatory notices on a customer's behalf; we coordinate closely with customer legal teams.

Priyom / Neha - quick technical confirmations:

• Turnaround: for forensic evidence exports (redacted request traces, API call logs, KV timelines) we can produce exports in 24-72 hours depending on scope. High-severity incidents (pager) get a faster SLA (under 8 hours to initial export).
• Formats: gzipped JSON for app traces; CSV/Parquet for aggregated metrics.
• Limitations: we do not provide raw disk images or private KMS key material. We will provide key IDs, rotation metadata, envelope encryption parameters, and KMS audit logs showing usage.
• Preservation: we can take forensic snapshots on request; images retained per contract (standard 14 days unless extended).

Suggested customer-facing notification wording:
"Redwood Inference detected and verified an incident that impacted [brief scope]. We will provide an incident summary and supporting artifacts within 72 hours of verification and will work directly with your security and legal teams to produce redacted logs and a detailed timeline for your review"
